units.leftText: These are the words which Moses spoke to all Israel beyond the Jordan in the wilderness, in the Arabah opposite Suf, between Paran, Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth, and Dizahab.
units.rightText: These are the words which Moses spake unto all Israel beyond the Jordan in the wilderness, in the Arabah over against Suph, between Paran, and Tophel, and Laban, and Hazeroth, and Di-zahab.

units.leftText: It is eleven days’ journey from Horeb by the way of Mount Seir to Kadesh Barnea.
units.rightText: It is eleven days’ journey from Horeb by the way of mount Seir unto Kadesh-barnea.

units.leftText: In the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, Moses spoke to the children of Israel according to all that the LORD had given him in commandment to them,
units.rightText: And it came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, that Moses spake unto the children of Israel, according unto all that Jehovah had given him in commandment unto them;

units.leftText: Beyond the Jordan, in the land of Moab, Moses began to declare this law, saying,
units.rightText: Beyond the Jordan, in the land of Moab, began Moses to declare this law, saying,

units.leftText: “The LORD our God spoke to us in Horeb, saying, ‘You have lived long enough at this mountain.
units.rightText: Jehovah our God spake unto us in Horeb, saying, Ye have dwelt long enough in this mountain:

units.leftText: Turn, and take your journey, and go to the hill country of the Amorites and to all the places near there: in the Arabah, in the hill country, in the lowland, in the South, by the seashore, in the land of the Canaanites, and in Lebanon as far as the great river, the river Euphrates.
units.rightText: turn you, and take your journey, and go to the hill-country of the Amorites, and unto all the places nigh thereunto, in the Arabah, in the hill-country, and in the lowland, and in the South, and by the sea-shore, the land of the Canaanites, and Lebanon, as far as the great river, the river Euphrates.

units.leftText: Behold, I have set the land before you. Go in and possess the land which the LORD swore to your fathers—to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob—to give to them and to their offspring after them.’”
units.rightText: Behold, I have set the land before you: go in and possess the land which Jehovah sware unto your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give unto them and to their seed after them.

units.leftText: I spoke to you at that time, saying, “I am not able to bear you myself alone.
units.rightText: And I spake unto you at that time, saying, I am not able to bear you myself alone:

units.leftText: The LORD your God has multiplied you, and behold, you are today as the stars of the sky for multitude.
units.rightText: Jehovah your God hath multiplied you, and, behold, ye are this day as the stars of heaven for multitude.

units.leftText: May the LORD, the God of your fathers, make you a thousand times as many as you are and bless you, as he has promised you!
units.rightText: Jehovah, the God of your fathers, make you a thousand times as many as ye are, and bless you, as he hath promised you!

units.leftText: How can I myself alone bear your problems, your burdens, and your strife?
units.rightText: How can I myself alone bear your cumbrance, and your burden, and your strife?

units.leftText: Take wise men of understanding who are respected among your tribes, and I will make them heads over you.”
units.rightText: Take you wise men, and understanding, and known, according to your tribes, and I will make them heads over you.

units.leftText: You answered me, and said, “The thing which you have spoken is good to do.”
units.rightText: And ye answered me, and said, The thing which thou hast spoken is good for us to do.

units.leftText: So I took the heads of your tribes, wise and respected men, and made them heads over you, captains of thousands, captains of hundreds, captains of fifties, captains of tens, and officers, according to your tribes.
units.rightText: So I took the heads of your tribes, wise men, and known, and made them heads over you, captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, and captains of fifties, and captains of tens, and officers, according to your tribes.

units.leftText: I commanded your judges at that time, saying, “Hear cases between your brothers and judge righteously between a man and his brother, and the foreigner who is living with him.
units.rightText: And I charged your judges at that time, saying, Hear the causes between your brethren, and judge righteously between a man and his brother, and the sojourner that is with him.

units.leftText: You shall not show partiality in judgment; you shall hear the small and the great alike. You shall not be afraid of the face of man, for the judgment is God’s. The case that is too hard for you, you shall bring to me, and I will hear it.”
units.rightText: Ye shall not respect persons in judgment; ye shall hear the small and the great alike; ye shall not be afraid of the face of man; for the judgment is God’s: and the cause that is too hard for you ye shall bring unto me, and I will hear it.

units.leftText: I commanded you at that time all the things which you should do.
units.rightText: And I commanded you at that time all the things which ye should do.

units.leftText: We traveled from Horeb and went through all that great and terrible wilderness which you saw, by the way to the hill country of the Amorites, as the LORD our God commanded us; and we came to Kadesh Barnea.
units.rightText: And we journeyed from Horeb, and went through all that great and terrible wilderness which ye saw, by the way to the hill-country of the Amorites, as Jehovah our God commanded us; and we came to Kadesh-barnea.

units.leftText: I said to you, “You have come to the hill country of the Amorites, which the LORD our God gives to us.
units.rightText: And I said unto you, Ye are come unto the hill-country of the Amorites, which Jehovah our God giveth unto us.

units.leftText: Behold, the LORD your God has set the land before you. Go up, take possession, as the LORD the God of your fathers has spoken to you. Don’t be afraid, neither be dismayed.”
units.rightText: Behold, Jehovah thy God hath set the land before thee: go up, take possession, as Jehovah, the God of thy fathers, hath spoken unto thee; fear not, neither be dismayed.

units.leftText: You came near to me, everyone of you, and said, “Let’s send men before us, that they may search the land for us, and bring back to us word of the way by which we must go up, and the cities to which we shall come.”
units.rightText: And ye came near unto me every one of you, and said, Let us send men before us, that they may search the land for us, and bring us word again of the way by which we must go up, and the cities unto which we shall come.

units.leftText: The thing pleased me well. I took twelve of your men, one man for every tribe.
units.rightText: And the thing pleased me well; and I took twelve men of you, one man for every tribe:

units.leftText: They turned and went up into the hill country, and came to the valley of Eshcol, and spied it out.
units.rightText: and they turned and went up into the hill-country, and came unto the valley of Eshcol, and spied it out.

units.leftText: They took some of the fruit of the land in their hands and brought it down to us, and brought us word again, and said, “It is a good land which the LORD our God gives to us.”
units.rightText: And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands, and brought it down unto us, and brought us word again, and said, It is a good land which Jehovah our God giveth unto us.

units.leftText: Yet you wouldn’t go up, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God.
units.rightText: Yet ye would not go up, but rebelled against the commandment of Jehovah your God:

units.leftText: You murmured in your tents, and said, “Because the LORD hated us, he has brought us out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites to destroy us.
units.rightText: and ye murmured in your tents, and said, Because Jehovah hated us, he hath brought us forth out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.

units.leftText: Where are we going up? Our brothers have made our heart melt, saying, ‘The people are greater and taller than we. The cities are great and fortified up to the sky. Moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakim there!’”
units.rightText: Whither are we going up? our brethren have made our heart to melt, saying, The people are greater and taller than we; the cities are great and fortified up to heaven; and moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakim there.

units.leftText: Then I said to you, “Don’t be terrified. Don’t be afraid of them.
units.rightText: Then I said unto you, Dread not, neither be afraid of them.

units.leftText: The LORD your God, who goes before you, he will fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes,
units.rightText: Jehovah your God who goeth before you, he will fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes,

units.leftText: and in the wilderness where you have seen how that the LORD your God carried you, as a man carries his son, in all the way that you went, until you came to this place.”
units.rightText: and in the wilderness, where thou hast seen how that Jehovah thy God bare thee, as a man doth bear his son, in all the way that ye went, until ye came unto this place.

units.leftText: Yet in this thing you didn’t believe the LORD your God,
units.rightText: Yet in this thing ye did not believe Jehovah your God,

units.leftText: who went before you on the way, to seek out a place for you to pitch your tents in: in fire by night, to show you by what way you should go, and in the cloud by day.
units.rightText: who went before you in the way, to seek you out a place to pitch your tents in, in fire by night, to show you by what way ye should go, and in the cloud by day.

units.leftText: The LORD heard the voice of your words and was angry, and swore, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah heard the voice of your words, and was wroth, and sware, saying,

units.leftText: “Surely not one of these men of this evil generation shall see the good land which I swore to give to your fathers,
units.rightText: Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation see the good land, which I sware to give unto your fathers,

units.leftText: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh. He shall see it. I will give the land that he has trodden on to him and to his children, because he has wholly followed the LORD.”
units.rightText: save Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it; and to him will I give the land that he hath trodden upon, and to his children, because he hath wholly followed Jehovah.

units.leftText: Also the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, saying, “You also shall not go in there.
units.rightText: Also Jehovah was angry with me for your sakes, saying, Thou also shalt not go in thither:

units.leftText: Joshua the son of Nun, who stands before you, shall go in there. Encourage him, for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.
units.rightText: Joshua the son of Nun, who standeth before thee, he shall go in thither: encourage thou him; for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.

units.leftText: Moreover your little ones, whom you said would be captured or killed, your children, who today have no knowledge of good or evil, shall go in there. I will give it to them, and they shall possess it.
units.rightText: Moreover your little ones, that ye said should be a prey, and your children, that this day have no knowledge of good or evil, they shall go in thither, and unto them will I give it, and they shall possess it.

units.leftText: But as for you, turn, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.”
units.rightText: But as for you, turn you, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.

units.leftText: Then you answered and said to me, “We have sinned against the LORD. We will go up and fight, according to all that the LORD our God commanded us.” Every man of you put on his weapons of war, and presumed to go up into the hill country.
units.rightText: Then ye answered and said unto me, We have sinned against Jehovah, we will go up and fight, according to all that Jehovah our God commanded us. And ye girded on every man his weapons of war, and were forward to go up into the hill-country.

units.leftText: The LORD said to me, “Tell them, ‘Don’t go up and don’t fight; for I am not among you, lest you be struck before your enemies.’”
units.rightText: And Jehovah said unto me, Say unto them, Go not up, neither fight; for I am not among you; lest ye be smitten before your enemies.

units.leftText: So I spoke to you, and you didn’t listen; but you rebelled against the commandment of the LORD, and were presumptuous, and went up into the hill country.
units.rightText: So I spake unto you, and ye hearkened not; but ye rebelled against the commandment of Jehovah, and were presumptuous, and went up into the hill-country.

units.leftText: The Amorites, who lived in that hill country, came out against you and chased you as bees do, and beat you down in Seir, even to Hormah.
units.rightText: And the Amorites, that dwelt in that hill-country, came out against you, and chased you, as bees do, and beat you down in Seir, even unto Hormah.

units.leftText: You returned and wept before the LORD, but the LORD didn’t listen to your voice, nor turn his ear to you.
units.rightText: And ye returned and wept before Jehovah; but Jehovah hearkened not to your voice, nor gave ear unto you.

units.leftText: So you stayed in Kadesh many days, according to the days that you remained.
units.rightText: So ye abode in Kadesh many days, according unto the days that ye abode there.

units.leftText: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea, as the LORD spoke to me; and we encircled Mount Seir many days.
units.rightText: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea, as Jehovah spake unto me; and we compassed mount Seir many days.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to me, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “You have encircled this mountain long enough. Turn northward.
units.rightText: Ye have compassed this mountain long enough: turn you northward.

units.leftText: Command the people, saying, ‘You are to pass through the border of your brothers, the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir; and they will be afraid of you. Therefore be careful.
units.rightText: And command thou the people, saying, Ye are to pass through the border of your brethren the children of Esau, that dwell in Seir; and they will be afraid of you. Take ye good heed unto yourselves therefore;

units.leftText: Don’t contend with them; for I will not give you any of their land, no, not so much as for the sole of the foot to tread on, because I have given Mount Seir to Esau for a possession.
units.rightText: contend not with them; for I will not give you of their land, no, not so much as for the sole of the foot to tread on; because I have given mount Seir unto Esau for a possession.

units.leftText: You shall purchase food from them for money, that you may eat. You shall also buy water from them for money, that you may drink.’”
units.rightText: Ye shall purchase food of them for money, that ye may eat; and ye shall also buy water of them for money, that ye may drink.

units.leftText: For the LORD your God has blessed you in all the work of your hands. He has known your walking through this great wilderness. These forty years, the LORD your God has been with you. You have lacked nothing.
units.rightText: For Jehovah thy God hath blessed thee in all the work of thy hand; he hath known thy walking through this great wilderness: these forty years Jehovah thy God hath been with thee; thou hast lacked nothing.

units.leftText: So we passed by from our brothers, the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir, from the way of the Arabah from Elath and from Ezion Geber. We turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.
units.rightText: So we passed by from our brethren the children of Esau, that dwell in Seir, from the way of the Arabah from Elath and from Ezion-geber.

units.rightText: And Jehovah said unto me, Vex not Moab, neither contend with them in battle; for I will not give thee of his land for a possession; because I have given Ar unto the children of Lot for a possession.

units.rightText: And the days in which we came from Kadesh-barnea, until we were come over the brook Zered, were thirty and eight years; until all the generation of the men of war were consumed from the midst of the camp, as Jehovah sware unto them.

leftNotes: 3:11 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters.

units.leftText: This land we took in possession at that time: from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, and half the hill country of Gilead with its cities, I gave to the Reubenites and to the Gadites;
units.rightText: And this land we took in possession at that time: from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, and half the hill-country of Gilead, and the cities thereof, gave I unto the Reubenites and to the Gadites:

units.leftText: and the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh—all the region of Argob, even all Bashan. (The same is called the land of Rephaim.
units.rightText: and the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, gave I unto the half-tribe of Manasseh; all the region of Argob, even all Bashan. (The same is called the land of Rephaim.

units.leftText: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the region of Argob, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and called them, even Bashan, after his own name, Havvoth Jair, to this day.)
units.rightText: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the region of Argob, unto the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and called them, even Bashan, after his own name, Havvoth-jair, unto this day.)

units.leftText: I gave Gilead to Machir.
units.rightText: And I gave Gilead unto Machir.

units.leftText: To the Reubenites and to the Gadites I gave from Gilead even to the valley of the Arnon, the middle of the valley, and its border, even to the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;
units.rightText: And unto the Reubenites and unto the Gadites I gave from Gilead even unto the valley of the Arnon, the middle of the valley, and the border thereof, even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;

units.leftText: the Arabah also, and the Jordan and its border, from Chinnereth even to the sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, under the slopes of Pisgah eastward.
units.rightText: the Arabah also, and the Jordan and the border thereof, from Chinnereth even unto the sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, under the slopes of Pisgah eastward.

units.leftText: I commanded you at that time, saying, “The LORD your God has given you this land to possess it. All of you men of valor shall pass over armed before your brothers, the children of Israel.
units.rightText: And I commanded you at that time, saying, Jehovah your God hath given you this land to possess it: ye shall pass over armed before your brethren the children of Israel, all the men of valor.

units.leftText: But your wives, and your little ones, and your livestock, (I know that you have much livestock), shall live in your cities which I have given you,
units.rightText: But your wives, and your little ones, and your cattle (I know that ye have much cattle), shall abide in your cities which I have given you,

units.leftText: until the LORD gives rest to your brothers, as to you, and they also possess the land which the LORD your God gives them beyond the Jordan. Then you shall each return to his own possession, which I have given you.”
units.rightText: until Jehovah give rest unto your brethren, as unto you, and they also possess the land which Jehovah your God giveth them beyond the Jordan: then shall ye return every man unto his possession, which I have given you.

units.leftText: I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, “Your eyes have seen all that the LORD your God has done to these two kings. So shall the LORD do to all the kingdoms where you go over.
units.rightText: And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, Thine eyes have seen all that Jehovah your God hath done unto these two kings: so shall Jehovah do unto all the kingdoms whither thou goest over.

units.leftText: You shall not fear them; for the LORD your God himself fights for you.”
units.rightText: Ye shall not fear them; for Jehovah your God, he it is that fighteth for you.

units.leftText: I begged GOD at that time, saying,
units.rightText: And I besought Jehovah at that time, saying,

units.leftText: “Lord GOD, you have begun to show your servant your greatness, and your strong hand. For what god is there in heaven or in earth that can do works like yours, and mighty acts like yours?
units.rightText: O Lord Jehovah, thou hast begun to show thy servant thy greatness, and thy strong hand: for what god is there in heaven or in earth, that can do according to thy works, and according to thy mighty acts?

units.leftText: Please let me go over and see the good land that is beyond the Jordan, that fine mountain, and Lebanon.”
units.rightText: Let me go over, I pray thee, and see the good land that is beyond the Jordan, that goodly mountain, and Lebanon.

units.leftText: But the LORD was angry with me because of you, and didn’t listen to me. The LORD said to me, “That is enough! Speak no more to me of this matter.
units.rightText: But Jehovah was wroth with me for your sakes, and hearkened not unto me; and Jehovah said unto me, Let it suffice thee; speak no more unto me of this matter.

units.leftText: Go up to the top of Pisgah, and lift up your eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and see with your eyes; for you shall not go over this Jordan.
units.rightText: Get thee up unto the top of Pisgah, and lift up thine eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and behold with thine eyes: for thou shalt not go over this Jordan.

units.leftText: But commission Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him; for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which you shall see.”
units.rightText: But charge Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him; for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which thou shalt see.

units.leftText: So we stayed in the valley near Beth Peor.
units.rightText: So we abode in the valley over against Beth-peor.

units.leftText: Now, Israel, listen to the statutes and to the ordinances which I teach you, to do them, that you may live and go in and possess the land which the LORD, the God of your fathers, gives you.
units.rightText: And now, O Israel, hearken unto the statutes and unto the ordinances, which I teach you, to do them; that ye may live, and go in and possess the land which Jehovah, the God of your fathers, giveth you.

units.leftText: You shall not add to the word which I command you, neither shall you take away from it, that you may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you.
units.rightText: Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall ye diminish from it, that ye may keep the commandments of Jehovah your God which I command you.

units.leftText: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did because of Baal Peor; for the LORD your God has destroyed all the men who followed Baal Peor from among you.
units.rightText: Your eyes have seen what Jehovah did because of Baal-peor; for all the men that followed Baal-peor, Jehovah thy God hath destroyed them from the midst of thee.

units.leftText: But you who were faithful to the LORD your God are all alive today.
units.rightText: But ye that did cleave unto Jehovah your God are alive every one of you this day.

units.leftText: Behold, I have taught you statutes and ordinances, even as the LORD my God commanded me, that you should do so in the middle of the land where you go in to possess it.
units.rightText: Behold, I have taught you statutes and ordinances, even as Jehovah my God commanded me, that ye should do so in the midst of the land whither ye go in to possess it.

units.leftText: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples who shall hear all these statutes and say, “Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.”
units.rightText: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples, that shall hear all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.

units.leftText: For what great nation is there that has a god so near to them as the LORD our God is whenever we call on him?
units.rightText: For what great nation is there, that hath a god so nigh unto them, as Jehovah our God is whensoever we call upon him?

units.leftText: What great nation is there that has statutes and ordinances so righteous as all this law which I set before you today?
units.rightText: And what great nation is there, that hath statutes and ordinances so righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day?

units.leftText: Only be careful, and keep your soul diligently, lest you forget the things which your eyes saw, and lest they depart from your heart all the days of your life; but make them known to your children and your children’s children—
units.rightText: Only take heed to thyself, and keep thy soul diligently, lest thou forget the things which thine eyes saw, and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life; but make them known unto thy children and thy children’s children;

units.leftText: the day that you stood before the LORD your God in Horeb, when the LORD said to me, “Assemble the people to me, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they live on the earth, and that they may teach their children.”
units.rightText: the day that thou stoodest before Jehovah thy God in Horeb, when Jehovah said unto me, Assemble me the people, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they live upon the earth, and that they may teach their children.

units.leftText: You came near and stood under the mountain. The mountain burned with fire to the heart of the sky, with darkness, cloud, and thick darkness.
units.rightText: And ye came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire unto the heart of heaven, with darkness, cloud, and thick darkness.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to you out of the middle of the fire: you heard the voice of words, but you saw no form; you only heard a voice.
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto you out of the midst of the fire: ye heard the voice of words, but ye saw no form; only ye heard a voice.

units.leftText: He declared to you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even the ten commandments. He wrote them on two stone tablets.
units.rightText: And he declared unto you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even the ten commandments; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone.

units.leftText: The LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and ordinances, that you might do them in the land where you go over to possess it.
units.rightText: And Jehovah commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and ordinances, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it.

units.leftText: Be very careful, for you saw no kind of form on the day that the LORD spoke to you in Horeb out of the middle of the fire,
units.rightText: Take ye therefore good heed unto yourselves; for ye saw no manner of form on the day that Jehovah spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire;

units.leftText: lest you corrupt yourselves, and make yourself a carved image in the form of any figure, the likeness of male or female,
units.rightText: lest ye corrupt yourselves, and make you a graven image in the form of any figure, the likeness of male or female,

units.leftText: the likeness of any animal that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged bird that flies in the sky,
units.rightText: the likeness of any beast that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged bird that flieth in the heavens,

units.leftText: the likeness of anything that creeps on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the water under the earth;
units.rightText: the likeness of anything that creepeth on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the water under the earth;

units.leftText: and lest you lift up your eyes to the sky, and when you see the sun and the moon and the stars, even all the army of the sky, you are drawn away and worship them, and serve them, which the LORD your God has allotted to all the peoples under the whole sky.
units.rightText: and lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun and the moon and the stars, even all the host of heaven, thou be drawn away and worship them, and serve them, which Jehovah thy God hath allotted unto all the peoples under the whole heaven.

units.leftText: But the LORD has taken you, and brought you out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be to him a people of inheritance, as it is today.
units.rightText: But Jehovah hath taken you, and brought you forth out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be unto him a people of inheritance, as at this day.

units.leftText: Furthermore the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, and swore that I should not go over the Jordan, and that I should not go in to that good land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance;
units.rightText: Furthermore Jehovah was angry with me for your sakes, and sware that I should not go over the Jordan, and that I should not go in unto that good land, which Jehovah thy God giveth thee for an inheritance:

units.leftText: but I must die in this land. I must not go over the Jordan, but you shall go over and possess that good land.
units.rightText: but I must die in this land, I must not go over the Jordan; but ye shall go over, and possess that good land.

units.leftText: Be careful, lest you forget the covenant of the LORD your God, which he made with you, and make yourselves a carved image in the form of anything which the LORD your God has forbidden you.
units.rightText: Take heed unto yourselves, lest ye forget the covenant of Jehovah your God, which he made with you, and make you a graven image in the form of anything which Jehovah thy God hath forbidden thee.

units.leftText: For the LORD your God is a devouring fire, a jealous God.
units.rightText: For Jehovah thy God is a devouring fire, a jealous God.

units.leftText: When you father children and children’s children, and you have been long in the land, and then corrupt yourselves, and make a carved image in the form of anything, and do that which is evil in the LORD your God’s sight to provoke him to anger,
units.rightText: When thou shalt beget children, and children’s children, and ye shall have been long in the land, and shall corrupt yourselves, and make a graven image in the form of anything, and shall do that which is evil in the sight of Jehovah thy God, to provoke him to anger;

units.leftText: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today, that you will soon utterly perish from off the land which you go over the Jordan to possess it. You will not prolong your days on it, but will utterly be destroyed.
units.rightText: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that ye shall soon utterly perish from off the land whereunto ye go over the Jordan to possess it; ye shall not prolong your days upon it, but shall utterly be destroyed.

units.leftText: The LORD will scatter you among the peoples, and you will be left few in number among the nations where the LORD will lead you away.
units.rightText: And Jehovah will scatter you among the peoples, and ye shall be left few in number among the nations, whither Jehovah shall lead you away.

units.leftText: There you will serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
units.rightText: And there ye shall serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.

units.leftText: But from there you shall seek the LORD your God, and you will find him when you search after him with all your heart and with all your soul.
units.rightText: But from thence ye shall seek Jehovah thy God, and thou shalt find him, when thou searchest after him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.

units.leftText: When you are in oppression, and all these things have come on you, in the latter days you shall return to the LORD your God and listen to his voice.
units.rightText: When thou art in tribulation, and all these things are come upon thee, in the latter days thou shalt return to Jehovah thy God, and hearken unto his voice:

units.leftText: For the LORD your God is a merciful God. He will not fail you nor destroy you, nor forget the covenant of your fathers which he swore to them.
units.rightText: for Jehovah thy God is a merciful God; he will not fail thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them.

units.leftText: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before you, since the day that God created man on the earth, and from the one end of the sky to the other, whether there has been anything as great as this thing is, or has been heard like it?
units.rightText: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before thee, since the day that God created man upon the earth, and from the one end of heaven unto the other, whether there hath been any such thing as this great thing is, or hath been heard like it?

units.leftText: Did a people ever hear the voice of God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as you have heard, and live?
units.rightText: Did ever a people hear the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as thou hast heard, and live?

units.leftText: Or has God tried to go and take a nation for himself from among another nation, by trials, by signs, by wonders, by war, by a mighty hand, by an outstretched arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?
units.rightText: Or hath God assayed to go and take him a nation from the midst of another nation, by trials, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by an outstretched arm, and by great terrors, according to all that Jehovah your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?

units.leftText: It was shown to you so that you might know that the LORD is God. There is no one else besides him.
units.rightText: Unto thee it was showed, that thou mightest know that Jehovah he is God; there is none else besides him.

units.leftText: Out of heaven he made you to hear his voice, that he might instruct you. On earth he made you to see his great fire; and you heard his words out of the middle of the fire.
units.rightText: Out of heaven he made thee to hear his voice, that he might instruct thee: and upon earth he made thee to see his great fire; and thou heardest his words out of the midst of the fire.

units.leftText: Because he loved your fathers, therefore he chose their offspring after them, and brought you out with his presence, with his great power, out of Egypt;
units.rightText: And because he loved thy fathers, therefore he chose their seed after them, and brought thee out with his presence, with his great power, out of Egypt;

units.leftText: to drive out nations from before you greater and mightier than you, to bring you in, to give you their land for an inheritance, as it is today.
units.rightText: to drive out nations from before thee greater and mightier than thou, to bring thee in, to give thee their land for an inheritance, as at this day.

units.leftText: Know therefore today, and take it to heart, that the LORD himself is God in heaven above and on the earth beneath. There is no one else.
units.rightText: Know therefore this day, and lay it to thy heart, that Jehovah he is God in heaven above and upon the earth beneath; there is none else.

units.leftText: You shall keep his statutes and his commandments which I command you today, that it may go well with you and with your children after you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which the LORD your God gives you for all time.
units.rightText: And thou shalt keep his statutes, and his commandments, which I command thee this day, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, and that thou mayest prolong thy days in the land, which Jehovah thy God giveth thee, for ever.

units.leftText: Then Moses set apart three cities beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise,
units.rightText: Then Moses set apart three cities beyond the Jordan toward the sunrising;

units.leftText: that the man slayer might flee there, who kills his neighbor unintentionally and didn’t hate him in time past, and that fleeing to one of these cities he might live:
units.rightText: that the manslayer might flee thither, that slayeth his neighbor unawares, and hated him not in time past; and that fleeing unto one of these cities he might live:

units.leftText: Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, for the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan for the Manassites.
units.rightText: namely, Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, for the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, for the Manassites.

units.leftText: This is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel.
units.rightText: And this is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel:

units.leftText: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the ordinances which Moses spoke to the children of Israel when they came out of Egypt,
units.rightText: these are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which Moses spake unto the children of Israel, when they came forth out of Egypt,

units.leftText: beyond the Jordan, in the valley opposite Beth Peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel struck when they came out of Egypt.
units.rightText: beyond the Jordan, in the valley over against Beth-peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel smote, when they came forth out of Egypt.

units.leftText: They took possession of his land and the land of Og king of Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise;
units.rightText: And they took his land in possession, and the land of Og king of Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan toward the sunrising;

units.leftText: from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, even to Mount Siyon (also called Hermon),
units.rightText: from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, even unto mount Sion (the same is Hermon),

units.leftText: and all the Arabah beyond the Jordan eastward, even to the sea of the Arabah, under the slopes of Pisgah.
units.rightText: and all the Arabah beyond the Jordan eastward, even unto the sea of the Arabah, under the slopes of Pisgah.

units.leftText: Moses called to all Israel, and said to them, “Hear, Israel, the statutes and the ordinances which I speak in your ears today, that you may learn them, and observe to do them.”
units.rightText: And Moses called unto all Israel, and said unto them, Hear, O Israel, the statutes and the ordinances which I speak in your ears this day, that ye may learn them, and observe to do them.

units.leftText: The LORD our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.
units.rightText: Jehovah our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.

units.leftText: The LORD didn’t make this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive today.
units.rightText: Jehovah made not this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive this day.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke with you face to face on the mountain out of the middle of the fire,
units.rightText: Jehovah spake with you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire

units.leftText: (I stood between the LORD and you at that time, to show you the LORD’s word; for you were afraid because of the fire, and didn’t go up onto the mountain) saying,
units.rightText: (I stood between Jehovah and you at that time, to show you the word of Jehovah: for ye were afraid because of the fire, and went not up into the mount), saying,

units.leftText: “I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
units.rightText: I am Jehovah thy God, who brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

units.leftText: “You shall have no other gods before me.
units.rightText: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.

units.leftText: “You shall not make a carved image for yourself—any likeness of what is in heaven above, or what is on the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth.
units.rightText: Thou shalt not make unto thee a graven image, nor any likeness of anything that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:

units.leftText: You shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them, for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children and on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me
units.rightText: thou shalt not bow down thyself unto them, nor serve them; for I, Jehovah, thy God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the third and upon the fourth generation of them that hate me;

units.leftText: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.
units.rightText: and showing lovingkindness unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments.

units.leftText: “You shall not misuse the name of the LORD your God; for the LORD will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.
units.rightText: Thou shalt not take the name of Jehovah thy God in vain: for Jehovah will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.
leftNotes: 5:11 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.
5:11 or, You shall not take the name of the LORD your God in vain;

units.leftText: “Observe the Sabbath day, to keep it holy, as the LORD your God commanded you.
units.rightText: Observe the sabbath day, to keep it holy, as Jehovah thy God commanded thee.

units.leftText: You shall labor six days, and do all your work;
units.rightText: Six days shalt thou labor, and do all thy work;

units.leftText: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God, in which you shall not do any work—neither you, nor your son, nor your daughter, nor your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your ox, nor your donkey, nor any of your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates; that your male servant and your female servant may rest as well as you.
units.rightText: but the seventh day is a sabbath unto Jehovah thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, nor thy man-servant, nor thy maid-servant, nor thine ox, nor thine ass, nor any of thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates; that thy man-servant and thy maid-servant may rest as well as thou.

units.leftText: You shall remember that you were a servant in the land of Egypt, and the LORD your God brought you out of there by a mighty hand and by an outstretched arm. Therefore the LORD your God commanded you to keep the Sabbath day.
units.rightText: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt, and Jehovah thy God brought thee out thence by a mighty hand and by an outstretched arm: therefore Jehovah thy God commanded thee to keep the sabbath day.

units.leftText: “Honor your father and your mother, as the LORD your God commanded you, that your days may be long and that it may go well with you in the land which the LORD your God gives you.
units.rightText: Honor thy father and thy mother, as Jehovah thy God commanded thee; that thy days may be long, and that it may go well with thee, in the land which Jehovah thy God giveth thee.

units.leftText: “You shall not murder.
units.rightText: Thou shalt not kill.

units.leftText: “You shall not commit adultery.
units.rightText: Neither shalt thou commit adultery.

units.leftText: “You shall not steal.
units.rightText: Neither shalt thou steal.

units.leftText: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.
units.rightText: Neither shalt thou bear false witness against thy neighbor.

units.leftText: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife. Neither shall you desire your neighbor’s house, his field, or his male servant, or his female servant, his ox, or his donkey, or anything that is your neighbor’s.”
units.rightText: Neither shalt thou covet thy neighbor’s wife; neither shalt thou desire thy neighbor’s house, his field, or his man-servant, or his maid-servant, his ox, or his ass, or anything that is thy neighbor’s.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke these words to all your assembly on the mountain out of the middle of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice. He added no more. He wrote them on two stone tablets, and gave them to me.
units.rightText: These words Jehovah spake unto all your assembly in the mount out of the midst of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice: and he added no more. And he wrote them upon two tables of stone, and gave them unto me.

units.leftText: When you heard the voice out of the middle of the darkness, while the mountain was burning with fire, you came near to me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;
units.rightText: And it came to pass, when ye heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness, while the mountain was burning with fire, that ye came near unto me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;

units.leftText: and you said, “Behold, the LORD our God has shown us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the middle of the fire. We have seen today that God does speak with man, and he lives.
units.rightText: and ye said, Behold, Jehovah our God hath showed us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire: we have seen this day that God doth speak with man, and he liveth.

units.leftText: Now therefore, why should we die? For this great fire will consume us. If we hear the LORD our God’s voice any more, then we shall die.
units.rightText: Now therefore why should we die? for this great fire will consume us: if we hear the voice of Jehovah our God any more, then we shall die.

units.leftText: For who is there of all flesh who has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as we have, and lived?
units.rightText: For who is there of all flesh, that hath heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we have, and lived?

units.leftText: Go near, and hear all that the LORD our God shall say, and tell us all that the LORD our God tells you; and we will hear it, and do it.”
units.rightText: Go thou near, and hear all that Jehovah our God shall say: and speak thou unto us all that Jehovah our God shall speak unto thee; and we will hear it, and do it.

units.leftText: The LORD heard the voice of your words when you spoke to me; and the LORD said to me, “I have heard the voice of the words of this people which they have spoken to you. They have well said all that they have spoken.
units.rightText: And Jehovah heard the voice of your words, when ye spake unto me; and Jehovah said unto me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoken unto thee: they have well said all that they have spoken.

units.leftText: Oh that there were such a heart in them that they would fear me and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them and with their children forever!
units.rightText: Oh that there were such a heart in them, that they would fear me, and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them, and with their children for ever!

units.leftText: “Go tell them, ‘Return to your tents.’
units.rightText: Go say to them, Return ye to your tents.

units.leftText: But as for you, stand here by me, and I will tell you all the commandments, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which you shall teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess.”
units.rightText: But as for thee, stand thou here by me, and I will speak unto thee all the commandment, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which thou shalt teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess it.

units.leftText: You shall observe to do therefore as the LORD your God has commanded you. You shall not turn away to the right hand or to the left.
units.rightText: Ye shall observe to do therefore as Jehovah your God hath commanded you: ye shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.

units.leftText: You shall walk in all the way which the LORD your God has commanded you, that you may live and that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which you shall possess.
units.rightText: Ye shall walk in all the way which Jehovah your God hath commanded you, that ye may live, and that it may be well with you, and that ye may prolong your days in the land which ye shall possess.

units.leftText: Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the ordinances, which the LORD your God commanded to teach you, that you might do them in the land that you go over to possess;
units.rightText: Now this is the commandment, the statutes, and the ordinances, which Jehovah your God commanded to teach you, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it;

units.leftText: that you might fear the LORD your God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command you—you, your son, and your son’s son, all the days of your life; and that your days may be prolonged.
units.rightText: that thou mightest fear Jehovah thy God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command thee, thou, and thy son, and thy son’s son, all the days of thy life; and that thy days may be prolonged.

units.leftText: Hear therefore, Israel, and observe to do it, that it may be well with you, and that you may increase mightily, as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has promised to you, in a land flowing with milk and honey.
units.rightText: Hear therefore, O Israel, and observe to do it; that it may be well with thee, and that ye may increase mightily, as Jehovah, the God of thy fathers, hath promised unto thee, in a land flowing with milk and honey.

units.leftText: Hear, Israel: The LORD is our God. The LORD is one.
units.rightText: Hear, O Israel: Jehovah our God is one Jehovah:

units.leftText: You shall love the LORD your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.
units.rightText: and thou shalt love Jehovah thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.

units.leftText: These words, which I command you today, shall be on your heart;
units.rightText: And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be upon thy heart;

units.leftText: and you shall teach them diligently to your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up.
units.rightText: and thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thy house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.

units.leftText: You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.
units.rightText: And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thy hand, and they shall be for frontlets between thine eyes.

units.leftText: You shall write them on the door posts of your house and on your gates.
units.rightText: And thou shalt write them upon the door-posts of thy house, and upon thy gates.

units.leftText: It shall be, when the LORD your God brings you into the land which he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give you, great and goodly cities which you didn’t build,
units.rightText: And it shall be, when Jehovah thy God shall bring thee into the land which he sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give thee, great and goodly cities, which thou buildest not,

units.leftText: and houses full of all good things which you didn’t fill, and cisterns dug out which you didn’t dig, vineyards and olive trees which you didn’t plant, and you shall eat and be full;
units.rightText: and houses full of all good things, which thou filledst not, and cisterns hewn out, which thou hewedst not, vineyards and olive-trees, which thou plantedst not, and thou shalt eat and be full;

units.leftText: then beware lest you forget the LORD, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
units.rightText: then beware lest thou forget Jehovah, who brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

units.leftText: You shall fear the LORD your God; and you shall serve him, and shall swear by his name.
units.rightText: Thou shalt fear Jehovah thy God; and him shalt thou serve, and shalt swear by his name.

units.leftText: You shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the peoples who are around you,
units.rightText: Ye shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the peoples that are round about you;

units.leftText: for the LORD your God among you is a jealous God, lest the anger of the LORD your God be kindled against you, and he destroy you from off the face of the earth.
units.rightText: for Jehovah thy God in the midst of thee is a jealous God; lest the anger of Jehovah thy God be kindled against thee, and he destroy thee from off the face of the earth.

units.leftText: You shall not tempt the LORD your God, as you tempted him in Massah.
units.rightText: Ye shall not tempt Jehovah your God, as ye tempted him in Massah.

units.leftText: You shall diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he has commanded you.
units.rightText: Ye shall diligently keep the commandments of Jehovah your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he hath commanded thee.

units.leftText: You shall do that which is right and good in the LORD’s sight, that it may be well with you and that you may go in and possess the good land which the LORD swore to your fathers,
units.rightText: And thou shalt do that which is right and good in the sight of Jehovah; that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayest go in and possess the good land which Jehovah sware unto thy fathers,

units.leftText: to thrust out all your enemies from before you, as the LORD has spoken.
units.rightText: to thrust out all thine enemies from before thee, as Jehovah hath spoken.

units.leftText: When your son asks you in time to come, saying, “What do the testimonies, the statutes, and the ordinances, which the LORD our God has commanded you mean?”
units.rightText: When thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What mean the testimonies, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which Jehovah our God hath commanded you?

units.leftText: then you shall tell your son, “We were Pharaoh’s slaves in Egypt. The LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand;
units.rightText: then thou shalt say unto thy son, We were Pharaoh’s bondmen in Egypt: and Jehovah brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand;

units.leftText: and the LORD showed great and awesome signs and wonders on Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his house, before our eyes;
units.rightText: and Jehovah showed signs and wonders, great and sore, upon Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his house, before our eyes;

units.leftText: and he brought us out from there, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he swore to our fathers.
units.rightText: and he brought us out from thence, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he sware unto our fathers.

units.leftText: The LORD commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear the LORD our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as we are today.
units.rightText: And Jehovah commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear Jehovah our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as at this day.

units.leftText: It shall be righteousness to us, if we observe to do all these commandments before the LORD our God, as he has commanded us.”
units.rightText: And it shall be righteousness unto us, if we observe to do all this commandment before Jehovah our God, as he hath commanded us.

units.leftText: When the LORD your God brings you into the land where you go to possess it, and casts out many nations before you—the Hittite, the Girgashite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite—seven nations greater and mightier than you;
units.rightText: When Jehovah thy God shall bring thee into the land whither thou goest to possess it, and shall cast out many nations before thee, the Hittite, and the Girgashite, and the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite, seven nations greater and mightier than thou;

units.leftText: and when the LORD your God delivers them up before you, and you strike them, then you shall utterly destroy them. You shall make no covenant with them, nor show mercy to them.
units.rightText: and when Jehovah thy God shall deliver them up before thee, and thou shalt smite them; then thou shalt utterly destroy them: thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor show mercy unto them;

units.leftText: You shall not make marriages with them. You shall not give your daughter to his son, nor shall you take his daughter for your son.
units.rightText: neither shalt thou make marriages with them; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son, nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son.

units.leftText: For that would turn away your sons from following me, that they may serve other gods. So the LORD’s anger would be kindled against you, and he would destroy you quickly.
units.rightText: For he will turn away thy son from following me, that they may serve other gods: so will the anger of Jehovah be kindled against you, and he will destroy thee quickly.

units.leftText: But you shall deal with them like this: you shall break down their altars, dash their pillars in pieces, cut down their Asherah poles, and burn their engraved images with fire.
units.rightText: But thus shall ye deal with them: ye shall break down their altars, and dash in pieces their pillars, and hew down their Asherim, and burn their graven images with fire.

units.leftText: For you are a holy people to the LORD your God. The LORD your God has chosen you to be a people for his own possession, above all peoples who are on the face of the earth.
units.rightText: For thou art a holy people unto Jehovah thy God: Jehovah thy God hath chosen thee to be a people for his own possession, above all peoples that are upon the face of the earth.

units.leftText: The LORD didn’t set his love on you nor choose you, because you were more in number than any people; for you were the fewest of all peoples;
units.rightText: Jehovah did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because ye were more in number than any people; for ye were the fewest of all peoples:

units.leftText: but because the LORD loves you, and because he desires to keep the oath which he swore to your fathers, the LORD has brought you out with a mighty hand and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
units.rightText: but because Jehovah loveth you, and because he would keep the oath which he sware unto your fathers, hath Jehovah brought you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

units.leftText: Know therefore that the LORD your God himself is God, the faithful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness to a thousand generations with those who love him and keep his commandments,
units.rightText: Know therefore that Jehovah thy God, he is God, the faithful God, who keepeth covenant and lovingkindness with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations,

units.leftText: and repays those who hate him to their face, to destroy them. He will not be slack to him who hates him. He will repay him to his face.
units.rightText: and repayeth them that hate him to their face, to destroy them: he will not be slack to him that hateth him, he will repay him to his face.

units.leftText: You shall therefore keep the commandments, the statutes, and the ordinances which I command you today, to do them.
units.rightText: Thou shalt therefore keep the commandment, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which I command thee this day, to do them.

units.leftText: It shall happen, because you listen to these ordinances and keep and do them, that the LORD your God will keep with you the covenant and the loving kindness which he swore to your fathers.
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass, because ye hearken to these ordinances, and keep and do them, that Jehovah thy God will keep with thee the covenant and the lovingkindness which he sware unto thy fathers:

units.leftText: He will love you, bless you, and multiply you. He will also bless the fruit of your body and the fruit of your ground, your grain and your new wine and your oil, the increase of your livestock and the young of your flock, in the land which he swore to your fathers to give you.
units.rightText: and he will love thee, and bless thee, and multiply thee; he will also bless the fruit of thy body and the fruit of thy ground, thy grain and thy new wine and thine oil, the increase of thy cattle and the young of thy flock, in the land which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee.

units.leftText: You will be blessed above all peoples. There won’t be male or female barren among you, or among your livestock.
units.rightText: Thou shalt be blessed above all peoples: there shall not be male or female barren among you, or among your cattle.

units.leftText: The LORD will take away from you all sickness; and he will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which you know, on you, but will lay them on all those who hate you.
units.rightText: And Jehovah will take away from thee all sickness; and none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which thou knowest, will he put upon thee, but will lay them upon all them that hate thee.

units.leftText: You shall consume all the peoples whom the LORD your God shall deliver to you. Your eye shall not pity them. You shall not serve their gods; for that would be a snare to you.
units.rightText: And thou shalt consume all the peoples that Jehovah thy God shall deliver unto thee; thine eye shall not pity them: neither shalt thou serve their gods; for that will be a snare unto thee.

units.leftText: If you shall say in your heart, “These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?”
units.rightText: If thou shalt say in thy heart, These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?

units.leftText: you shall not be afraid of them. You shall remember well what the LORD your God did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt:
units.rightText: thou shalt not be afraid of them: thou shalt well remember what Jehovah thy God did unto Pharaoh, and unto all Egypt;

units.leftText: the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs, the wonders, the mighty hand, and the outstretched arm, by which the LORD your God brought you out. So shall the LORD your God do to all the peoples of whom you are afraid.
units.rightText: the great trials which thine eyes saw, and the signs, and the wonders, and the mighty hand, and the outstretched arm, whereby Jehovah thy God brought thee out: so shall Jehovah thy God do unto all the peoples of whom thou art afraid.

units.leftText: Moreover the LORD your God will send the hornet among them, until those who are left, and hide themselves, perish from before you.
units.rightText: Moreover Jehovah thy God will send the hornet among them, until they that are left, and hide themselves, perish from before thee.

units.leftText: You shall not be scared of them; for the LORD your God is among you, a great and awesome God.
units.rightText: Thou shalt not be affrighted at them; for Jehovah thy God is in the midst of thee, a great God and a terrible.

units.leftText: The LORD your God will cast out those nations before you little by little. You may not consume them at once, lest the animals of the field increase on you.
units.rightText: And Jehovah thy God will cast out those nations before thee by little and little: thou mayest not consume them at once, lest the beasts of the field increase upon thee.

units.leftText: But the LORD your God will deliver them up before you, and will confuse them with a great confusion, until they are destroyed.
units.rightText: But Jehovah thy God will deliver them up before thee, and will discomfit them with a great discomfiture, until they be destroyed.

units.leftText: He will deliver their kings into your hand, and you shall make their name perish from under the sky. No one will be able to stand before you until you have destroyed them.
units.rightText: And he will deliver their kings into thy hand, and thou shalt make their name to perish from under heaven: there shall no man be able to stand before thee, until thou have destroyed them.

units.leftText: You shall burn the engraved images of their gods with fire. You shall not covet the silver or the gold that is on them, nor take it for yourself, lest you be snared in it; for it is an abomination to the LORD your God.
units.rightText: The graven images of their gods shall ye burn with fire: thou shalt not covet the silver or the gold that is on them, nor take it unto thee, lest thou be snared therein; for it is an abomination to Jehovah thy God.

units.leftText: You shall not bring an abomination into your house and become a devoted thing like it. You shall utterly detest it. You shall utterly abhor it; for it is a devoted thing.
units.rightText: And thou shalt not bring an abomination into thy house, and become a devoted thing like unto it: thou shalt utterly detest it, and thou shalt utterly abhor it; for it is a devoted thing.

units.leftText: You shall observe to do all the commandments which I command you today, that you may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which the LORD swore to your fathers.
units.rightText: All the commandment which I command thee this day shall ye observe to do, that ye may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which Jehovah sware unto your fathers.

units.leftText: You shall remember all the way which the LORD your God has led you these forty years in the wilderness, that he might humble you, to test you, to know what was in your heart, whether you would keep his commandments or not.
units.rightText: And thou shalt remember all the way which Jehovah thy God hath led thee these forty years in the wilderness, that he might humble thee, to prove thee, to know what was in thy heart, whether thou wouldest keep his commandments, or not.

units.leftText: He humbled you, allowed you to be hungry, and fed you with manna, which you didn’t know, neither did your fathers know, that he might teach you that man does not live by bread only, but man lives by every word that proceeds out of the LORD’s mouth.
units.rightText: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by everything that proceedeth out of the mouth of Jehovah doth man live.

units.leftText: Your clothing didn’t grow old on you, neither did your foot swell, these forty years.
units.rightText: Thy raiment waxed not old upon thee, neither did thy foot swell, these forty years.

units.leftText: You shall consider in your heart that as a man disciplines his son, so the LORD your God disciplines you.
units.rightText: And thou shalt consider in thy heart, that, as a man chasteneth his son, so Jehovah thy God chasteneth thee.

units.leftText: You shall keep the commandments of the LORD your God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.
units.rightText: And thou shalt keep the commandments of Jehovah thy God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.

units.leftText: For the LORD your God brings you into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of springs, and underground water flowing into valleys and hills;
units.rightText: For Jehovah thy God bringeth thee into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains and springs, flowing forth in valleys and hills;

units.leftText: a land of wheat, barley, vines, fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of olive trees and honey;
units.rightText: a land of wheat and barley, and vines and fig-trees and pomegranates; a land of olive-trees and honey;

units.leftText: a land in which you shall eat bread without scarcity, you shall not lack anything in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills you may dig copper.
units.rightText: a land wherein thou shalt eat bread without scarceness, thou shalt not lack anything in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills thou mayest dig copper.

units.leftText: You shall eat and be full, and you shall bless the LORD your God for the good land which he has given you.
units.rightText: And thou shalt eat and be full, and thou shalt bless Jehovah thy God for the good land which he hath given thee.

units.leftText: Beware lest you forget the LORD your God, in not keeping his commandments, his ordinances, and his statutes, which I command you today;
units.rightText: Beware lest thou forget Jehovah thy God, in not keeping his commandments, and his ordinances, and his statutes, which I command thee this day:

units.leftText: lest, when you have eaten and are full, and have built fine houses and lived in them;
units.rightText: lest, when thou hast eaten and art full, and hast built goodly houses, and dwelt therein;

units.leftText: and when your herds and your flocks multiply, and your silver and your gold is multiplied, and all that you have is multiplied;
units.rightText: and when thy herds and thy flocks multiply, and thy silver and thy gold is multiplied, and all that thou hast is multiplied;

units.leftText: then your heart might be lifted up, and you forget the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage;
units.rightText: then thy heart be lifted up, and thou forget Jehovah thy God, who brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage;

units.leftText: who led you through the great and terrible wilderness, with venomous snakes and scorpions, and thirsty ground where there was no water; who poured water for you out of the rock of flint;
units.rightText: who led thee through the great and terrible wilderness, wherein were fiery serpents and scorpions, and thirsty ground where was no water; who brought thee forth water out of the rock of flint;

units.leftText: who fed you in the wilderness with manna, which your fathers didn’t know, that he might humble you, and that he might prove you, to do you good at your latter end;
units.rightText: who fed thee in the wilderness with manna, which thy fathers knew not; that he might humble thee, and that he might prove thee, to do thee good at thy latter end:

units.leftText: and lest you say in your heart, “My power and the might of my hand has gotten me this wealth.”
units.rightText: and lest thou say in thy heart, My power and the might of my hand hath gotten me this wealth.

units.leftText: But you shall remember the LORD your God, for it is he who gives you power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he swore to your fathers, as it is today.
units.rightText: But thou shalt remember Jehovah thy God, for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth; that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers, as at this day.

units.leftText: It shall be, if you shall forget the LORD your God, and walk after other gods, and serve them and worship them, I testify against you today that you shall surely perish.
units.rightText: And it shall be, if thou shalt forget Jehovah thy God, and walk after other gods, and serve them, and worship them, I testify against you this day that ye shall surely perish.

units.leftText: As the nations that the LORD makes to perish before you, so you shall perish, because you wouldn’t listen to the LORD your God’s voice.
units.rightText: As the nations that Jehovah maketh to perish before you, so shall ye perish; because ye would not hearken unto the voice of Jehovah your God.

units.leftText: Hear, Israel! You are to pass over the Jordan today, to go in to dispossess nations greater and mightier than yourself, cities great and fortified up to the sky,
units.rightText: Hear, O Israel: thou art to pass over the Jordan this day, to go in to dispossess nations greater and mightier than thyself, cities great and fortified up to heaven,

units.leftText: a people great and tall, the sons of the Anakim, whom you know, and of whom you have heard say, “Who can stand before the sons of Anak?”
units.rightText: a people great and tall, the sons of the Anakim, whom thou knowest, and of whom thou hast heard say, Who can stand before the sons of Anak?

units.leftText: Know therefore today that the LORD your God is he who goes over before you as a devouring fire. He will destroy them and he will bring them down before you. So you shall drive them out and make them perish quickly, as the LORD has spoken to you.
units.rightText: Know therefore this day, that Jehovah thy God is he who goeth over before thee as a devouring fire; he will destroy them, and he will bring them down before thee: so shalt thou drive them out, and make them to perish quickly, as Jehovah hath spoken unto thee.

units.leftText: Don’t say in your heart, after the LORD your God has thrust them out from before you, “For my righteousness the LORD has brought me in to possess this land;” because the LORD drives them out before you because of the wickedness of these nations.
units.rightText: Speak not thou in thy heart, after that Jehovah thy God hath thrust them out from before thee, saying, For my righteousness Jehovah hath brought me in to possess this land; whereas for the wickedness of these nations Jehovah doth drive them out from before thee.

units.leftText: Not for your righteousness or for the uprightness of your heart do you go in to possess their land; but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD your God does drive them out from before you, and that he may establish the word which the LORD swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
units.rightText: Not for thy righteousness, or for the uprightness of thy heart, dost thou go in to possess their land; but for the wickedness of these nations Jehovah thy God doth drive them out from before thee, and that he may establish the word which Jehovah sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

units.leftText: Know therefore that the LORD your God doesn’t give you this good land to possess for your righteousness, for you are a stiff-necked people.
units.rightText: Know therefore, that Jehovah thy God giveth thee not this good land to possess it for thy righteousness; for thou art a stiffnecked people.

units.leftText: Remember, and don’t forget, how you provoked the LORD your God to wrath in the wilderness. From the day that you left the land of Egypt until you came to this place, you have been rebellious against the LORD.
units.rightText: Remember, forget thou not, how thou provokedst Jehovah thy God to wrath in the wilderness: from the day that thou wentest forth out of the land of Egypt, until ye came unto this place, ye have been rebellious against Jehovah.

units.leftText: Also in Horeb you provoked the LORD to wrath, and the LORD was angry with you to destroy you.
units.rightText: Also in Horeb ye provoked Jehovah to wrath, and Jehovah was angry with you to destroy you.

units.leftText: When I had gone up onto the mountain to receive the stone tablets, even the tablets of the covenant which the LORD made with you, then I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water.
units.rightText: When I was gone up into the mount to receive the tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant which Jehovah made with you, then I abode in the mount forty days and forty nights; I did neither eat bread nor drink water.

units.leftText: The LORD delivered to me the two stone tablets written with God’s finger. On them were all the words which the LORD spoke with you on the mountain out of the middle of the fire in the day of the assembly.
units.rightText: And Jehovah delivered unto me the two tables of stone written with the finger of God; and on them was written according to all the words, which Jehovah spake with you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly.

units.leftText: It came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights that the LORD gave me the two stone tablets, even the tablets of the covenant.
units.rightText: And it came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights, that Jehovah gave me the two tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant.

units.leftText: The LORD said to me, “Arise, get down quickly from here; for your people whom you have brought out of Egypt have corrupted themselves. They have quickly turned away from the way which I commanded them. They have made a molten image for themselves!”
units.rightText: And Jehovah said unto me, Arise, get thee down quickly from hence; for thy people that thou hast brought forth out of Egypt have corrupted themselves; they are quickly turned aside out of the way which I commanded them; they have made them a molten image.

units.leftText: Furthermore the LORD spoke to me, saying, “I have seen these people, and behold, they are a stiff-necked people.
units.rightText: Furthermore Jehovah spake unto me, saying, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:

units.leftText: Leave me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under the sky; and I will make of you a nation mightier and greater than they.”
units.rightText: let me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under heaven; and I will make of thee a nation mightier and greater than they.

units.leftText: So I turned and came down from the mountain, and the mountain was burning with fire. The two tablets of the covenant were in my two hands.
